about: The Workbench icons of the TimmyTime drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/timmy.png) is Timmy's first standing frame from the game's own res/player/player.bmp, scaled to 128 x 128, GPL-3 or later like the game. TimmyTime-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, TimmyTime.info beside the drawer. ReadMe.info is also copied for Manual.txt, COPYING.txt, Controls and Licences.txt; Data.info is the User drawer's icon.
